summary: Improve committee mandates, risk escalation and effective board reporting through applied governance exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Effective board reporting turns committee oversight into concise, evidence-based updates and clear requests for board decisions. For committee chairs, company secretaries and governance professionals, the work includes clarifying mandates and tracking actions through to closure. The course develops practical skills in assessing committee effectiveness, escalating risks, coordinating assurance and presenting control evidence in board packs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, support or oversee board committee work and need to improve the quality of committee decisions, records and reporting.
modules: OECD Principles and Annual Committee Cycle
prerequisites: Prior experience supporting, serving on or advising a board or board committee is recommended. You should be able to work with committee papers, minutes or governance records. No coding is required.
